theorem _root_.CompressionEval.fresh_sets_logic_08 {α : Type*} (s t u : Set α) (hst : s ⊆ t) (htu : t ⊆ u) (hus : u ⊆ s) :
  s=t ∧ t=u :=
by exact ⟨Set.Subset.antisymm hst (htu.trans hus), Set.Subset.antisymm htu (hus.trans hst)⟩
